sloka: अभिमानम् च मानम् च त्यक्त्वा वर्तस्व मातृषु ।अनु राजान मार्याम् च कैकेयीमम्ब कारय ॥२-५८-१९॥
transliteration: abhimānam ca mānam ca tyaktvā vartasva mātṛṣu ।anu rājāna māryām ca kaikeyīmamba kāraya ॥2-58-19॥

translations.english: 'O mother, conduct yourself with other mothers without pride and egoism. Ensure that venerable Kaikeyi remains welldisposed towards the king.
